2016-04-08T14:59:49.472081+00:00 shinyapps[64795]:   RGL: unable to open X11 display

Hope this helps.
-Tareef

parts: Thanks Hsunyi, just to confirm, the issue turned out to be a curl issue and so this issue is resolved.  :)
On Sunday, April 10, 2016, Hsun-Yi Hsieh <hhsie...@gmail.com> wrote:

Thank you so much for helping out, Tareef. The issue is not resolved. It was just because I used curl, which did not support the function getURL in the App. Changing to RCurl resolved the problem.  

Best,
Hsunyi

On Friday, April 8, 2016 at 12:39:32 PM UTC-4, Tareef Kawaf wrote:
None of these should be taking a dependency on rgl to my knowledge.  If you could share your code with me, I can try to run it locally and see if I see the same issue.

On Fri, Apr 8, 2016 at 12:17 PM, Hsun-Yi Hsieh <hhsie...@gmail.com> wrote:
Thank you, Tareef. I only have 
library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(curl)
library(Hmisc)

Would it be a problem of ggplot2? How could I get away from it?

Best,
Hsunyi


On Friday, April 8, 2016 at 11:51:28 AM UTC-4, Tareef Kawaf wrote:
I don't know :) Some package you are using is making this call I suspect. 

On Fri, Apr 8, 2016 at 11:49 AM, Hsun-Yi Hsieh <hhsie...@gmail.com> wrote:
Thank you, Tareef. My code does not include an rgl package, however. I wonder how would the rgl message appear in the report?

Best,
Hsunyi

On Friday, April 8, 2016 at 11:41:25 AM UTC-4, Tareef Kawaf wrote:
Hi Hsun-Yi,
It looks like you may be using an rgl package that is trying to get access to the X11 display. I have seen an example of how to get that to work here:  http://trestletech.github.io/shinyRGL/
Here are the lines that gave me the hint.

-Tareef
